cases.name: LaShonda "Shonda" Wilkerson
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "LaShonda Wilkerson, a beloved certified medical assistant at Piedmont Hospital, has peacefully passed away in Augusta, Georgia.

Throughout her career, LaShonda touched the lives of many patients with her compassionate care and unwavering dedication to her work. Her colleagues remember her as a beacon of light in the hospital, always ready to lend a helping hand and offer words of comfort to those in need.

LaShonda's legacy will continue to live on in the hearts of who knew her. She is survived by her loving family and friends who will miss dearly. During this time of mourning, let us come together to celebrate the remarkable life of LaShonda Wilkerson.

In honor of LaShonda's memory, let us cherish the moments we shared with her and carry forward the lessons she imparted upon us. May she rest in peace knowing that she made a lasting impact on everyone fortunate enough to have known her."
cases.narrative: He shot at her multiple times and shot her in the chest.
